dossier.stage_and_modality: Clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies with CD19 CAR-T program entering clinical development.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases, with in vivo CD19 CAR-T program specifically targeting autoimmune indications.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology that delivers CAR-T therapies directly in the body rather than ex vivo manufacturing.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo delivery approach eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and patient-specific production required by traditional CAR-T therapies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Raised $122 million Series B funding in May 2026 and strengthened advisory board with key appointments as CD19 program advances to clinic.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with in vivo gene editing platform. Currently has TSRA-196 in recruiting Phase 1/2 trial for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Strongest preclinical data disclosed for in vivo sickle cell therapy presented at ASGCT 2026. Also advancing preclinical in vivo CAR-T applications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD) in clinical development with TSRA-196. Sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications in preclinical development.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo gene editing platform technology. Specific delivery mechanism not disclosed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach that challenges traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy methods. Platform appears capable of addressing multiple therapeutic areas including genetic diseases and cancer immunotherapy.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented strongest preclinical data for in vivo sickle cell therapy and CAR-T advancements at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing antigen-driven CAR-T (adCAR-T) expansion technology. The approach enables in vivo CAR-T cell programming without traditional ex vivo manufacturing.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical proof-of-concept data presented at ASGCT 2026 annual meeting in May. The data demonstrates the feasibility of their antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method.
dossier.delivery_approach: Antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method that bypasses manufacturing bottlenecks while avoiding systemic vector delivery risks. The technology enables rapid, physiological CAR-T cell programming in vivo.
dossier.key_differentiators: Novel adCAR-T approach that eliminates traditional ex vivo manufacturing requirements. The method avoids systemic vector delivery risks associated with other in vivo CAR-T platforms.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical proof-of-concept data at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026. Multiple oral and poster presentations were delivered at the conference.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies. Currently has one active Phase 1 dose-escalation trial (NCT06528301) recruiting patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial ongoing for UB-VV111 in relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia, but no efficacy or safety data disclosed yet. No published preclinical data available.
dossier.indications_pursued: B-cell hematologic malignancies including large B-cell lymphoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and multiple myeloma. Focus appears to be on relapsed/refractory settings.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology, with UB-VV500 described as a dual-target approach for multiple myeloma. Specific delivery mechanism not disclosed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual-target CAR-T approach as evidenced by UB-VV500 program for multiple myeloma. In vivo delivery eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing required by traditional CAR-T therapies.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 announcement of UB-VV500 dual-target in vivo CAR-T data presentation at American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy Annual Meeting, revealing multiple myeloma program expansion.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo cell therapy approaches with lead asset CPTX2309.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients in Phase 1 trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309, assessing safety and tolerability.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting autoimmune diseases including rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapy with lead asset KLN-1010 currently recruiting patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT07075185) evaluating safety, tolerability, and recommended Phase 2 dose of KLN-1010 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma, specifically targeting relapsed or refractory disease populations.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T delivery platform, though specific delivery mechanism details not disclosed in available data.
dossier.last_significant_event: Eli Lilly acquisition announced in April 2026 for deal worth up to $7 billion, representing major pharmaceutical validation of the in vivo CAR-T approach.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early-phase clinical development with in vivo CAR-T cell therapy approach. Multiple Phase 1 trials recruiting across hematologic malignancies and autoimmune diseases.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory B-cell hematologic malignancies including multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also targeting refractory autoimmune diseases with CD19/BCMA dual targeting.
dossier.delivery_approach: Injectable in vivo CAR-T platform with lead assets JY231 for B-cell malignancies and JY232 for multiple myeloma.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual CD19/BCMA targeting approach for autoimmune diseases represents novel application of in vivo CAR-T beyond oncology indications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial for JY232 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (NCT07336823) currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with two active recruiting trials testing HN2301 and HN2302 assets in autoimmune diseases. Multiple trials suggest an in vivo approach but specific delivery modality not disclosed in available data.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No clinical data has been disclosed from the ongoing Phase 1 trials. One trial (NCT06965309) for refractory myasthenia gravis was terminated with no reported results.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and systemic sclerosis (scleroderma). Focus appears to be on refractory autoimmune conditions.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT07556120 for generalized myasthenia gravis with HN2301, currently in not-yet-recruiting status.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company focused on in vivo CAR-T cell engineering using both viral and non-viral vector approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells independent of double-stranded DNA breaks, as reported in Nature.
dossier.indications_pursued: Cancer, autoimmune diseases, and systemic rheumatic diseases.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform utilizing both viral vectors and non-viral nanotechnology-enhanced delivery systems for in vivo CAR-T generation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo CAR-T manufacturing approach that bypasses ex vivo production bottlenecks and enables immediate treatment at scale. Non-viral integration technology that operates independently of double-stranded DNA breaks.
dossier.last_significant_event: Publication in Nature (April 2026) demonstrating non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing non-viral cell therapies in partnership with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI.
dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral delivery platform developed through Center of Excellence partnership with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI.
dossier.key_differentiators: Non-viral approach to cell therapy development distinguishes from traditional viral delivery methods.
dossier.last_significant_event: Established Center of Excellence partnership with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI for advanced non-viral cell therapy development in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell engineering using their TRAC platform technology.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First-in-primate in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering data presented at ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.delivery_approach: TRAC platform for direct in vivo T cell engineering to generate CAR-T cells.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo CAR-T cell engineering approach that directly modifies T cells in the body rather than requiring ex vivo manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: Late-breaking oral presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting demonstrating first-in-primate in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering data in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing gene therapy approaches, with active recruitment for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease treatment using EN-374.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374, plus historical development in sickle cell disease and stem cell mobilization applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 clinical trial (NCT06876363) for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, currently recruiting participants.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapies. Currently has three active Phase 1 trials with assets SC262 and SC291.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for SG293 surrogate demonstrated cell-specific delivery, potent CAR-T cell generation, and deep B cell depletion in non-human primates as of May 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematologic malignancies including non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Also pursuing autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform that enables direct delivery and generation of CAR-T cells in patients without ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.key_differentiators: Cell-specific delivery mechanism for in vivo CAR-T generation and hypoimmune cell therapy platform. Developing both oncology and autoimmune applications with the same core technology.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical data for in vivo CAR-T therapy SG293 showing potent activity and B cell depletion in non-human primates in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with intramuscular delivery approach for solid tumor indication (EVM14).
dossier.indications_pursued: Selected solid tumors (EVM14), primary membranous nephropathy (EVER001), primary IgA nephropathy (Nefecon), and SARS-CoV-2 infection (PTX-COVID19-B).
dossier.delivery_approach: Intramuscular administration for EVM14; oral administration for EVER001 BTK inhibitor.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is described as a highly selective, oral, reversible, covalent BTK inhibitor with high selectivity over other kinases for proteinuric glomerular diseases.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 recruiting trial (NCT07095868) evaluating EVM14 intramuscular administration alone and in combination with pembrolizumab in solid tumors.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles. Two active recruiting Phase 1 trials are underway.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Limited clinical data available as both Phase 1 trials are currently recruiting. One trial (NCT07413341) is testing TI-0032-III, a circular RNA-encoded CD19 CAR-T therapy in autoimmune patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjogren's syndrome. Also conducting healthy volunteer studies with asset ORN252.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) targeting T cells that encapsulate circular RNA encoding chimeric antigen receptors. Platform appears to focus on circular RNA as the therapeutic modality.
dossier.key_differentiators: Uses circular RNA technology for in vivo CAR-T generation rather than traditional approaches. Targets autoimmune diseases with CD19 CAR-T, which is distinctive from typical oncology applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: May 2026 presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting showcasing clinical-ready circular RNA in vivo CAR-T pipeline. Two Phase 1 trials currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing autologous CAR-T cell therapies. Currently has three active clinical trials recruiting patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma targeting GPRC5D antigen and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma targeting GPC3 antigen.
dossier.delivery_approach: Traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell manufacturing with autologous T cell modification and reinfusion approach.
dossier.key_differentiators: Targeting GPRC5D for multiple myeloma and GPC3 for hepatocellular carcinoma with their OriCAR-017 and Ori-C101 products respectively.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of first U.S. clinical study (NCT06271252) for OriCAR-017 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: The company is developing ex vivo CAR-T therapies with multiple assets in Phase 1/2 clinical trials. Their approach focuses on traditional autologous CAR-T cell manufacturing rather than in vivo delivery methods.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: CT041 targeting claudin18.2 for gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer has advanced to Phase 1b/2 trials across multiple studies. Zevorcabtagene autoleucel for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma has progressed to post-marketing Phase IV observational studies.
dossier.indications_pursued: The company targets solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma, as well as hematological malignancies specifically relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Their pipeline spans digestive system cancers and blood cancers.
dossier.delivery_approach: CARsgen employs traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell manufacturing using autologous T cells extracted from patients, modified outside the body, and reinfused. This is a conventional CAR-T approach rather than in vivo delivery technology.
dossier.key_differentiators: The company's focus on claudin18.2 targeting in solid tumors represents a distinct approach to challenging digestive system cancers. Their advancement to commercial-stage products in multiple myeloma demonstrates clinical execution capability.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of CT011 Phase 1b trial for hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence after surgical resection, representing expansion into liver cancer indications.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Multiple Phase 1 and Phase 3 trials ongoing with both in vivo (IMV101, IMV102) and ex vivo CAR-T (IMC002) approaches. The company appears to have both conventional CAR-T and in vivo CAR-T programs in clinical development.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 trial for IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma represents the most advanced program. No specific efficacy or safety data has been disclosed from any trials.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma, plus solid tumors focusing on CLDN18.2-positive gastric, pancreatic, and other digestive system cancers.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach using both in vivo delivery (IMV101, IMV102) and conventional ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing (IMC002). Specific in vivo delivery mechanisms are not disclosed.
dossier.key_differentiators: Portfolio spans both hematologic and solid tumor indications with apparent in vivo CAR-T capability. CLDN18.2 targeting in solid tumors represents a clinically validated approach.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT07493135 for IMV102 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, representing expansion of in vivo platform to hematologic indications.
